units.title: Roman Poets
units.blurb: Lucretius on atoms and Virgil on farms, shepherds and the founding of Rome.

units.title: Lives and Histories
units.blurb: Plutarch's paired lives of Greeks and Romans, and Tacitus on the emperors.

units.title: Stoics and Plotinus
units.blurb: A freed slave and an emperor on calm in hard times, and Plotinus on the One.

units.title: Numbers, Stars and Medicine
units.blurb: Nicomachus on number, Ptolemy's astronomy and Galen's medicine.

units.title: Augustine
units.blurb: The Confessions, The City of God and On Christian Doctrine.

topics.title: Lucretius: On the Nature of Things
topics.short: A poem that explains the world as atoms moving in the void, to free readers from the fear of death and the gods.

topics.title: Virgil: Eclogues and Georgics
topics.short: Shepherds' songs and a long poem on farming: plowing, vines, cattle and bees.

topics.title: Virgil: The Aeneid
topics.short: Aeneas escapes burning Troy and, by duty more than desire, founds the people who will become Rome.

topics.title: Plutarch: Lives of the Greeks
topics.short: Character studies of Greek lawgivers, generals and kings, written to teach by example.

topics.title: Plutarch: Lives of the Romans
topics.short: The heroes and villains of the Roman Republic, paired with Greeks so readers can compare them.

topics.title: Tacitus: The Annals and The Histories
topics.short: A senator's sharp history of the first emperors, from Tiberius to the year of four emperors.

topics.title: Epictetus: Discourses
topics.short: A freed slave teaches that some things are up to us and some are not, and that peace comes from knowing which.

topics.title: Marcus Aurelius: Meditations
topics.short: A Roman emperor's private notebook: reminders to be just, patient and calm, written in army camps.

topics.title: Plotinus: The Enneads
topics.short: Everything flows from the One, and the soul can turn inward and climb back toward it.

topics.title: Nicomachus: Introduction to Arithmetic
topics.short: Even and odd, prime and composite, perfect numbers and figurate numbers: the arithmetic schools taught for a thousand years.

topics.title: Ptolemy: The Almagest
topics.short: The great book of ancient astronomy: an Earth-centered system of circles that predicted the planets for 1,400 years.

topics.title: Galen: On the Natural Faculties
topics.short: How the body grows, takes in food and gets rid of waste, argued from experiments on living things.

topics.title: Augustine: Confessions
topics.short: A life told as a prayer: a restless young man's search, his mother's faith, and his conversion in a garden.

topics.title: Augustine: The City of God
topics.short: Written after Rome was sacked: two cities, one built on love of self and one on love of God, run through all of history.

topics.title: Augustine: On Christian Doctrine
topics.short: How to read and teach the Bible: signs and things, plain and figurative meaning, and the uses of rhetoric.
